ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels forming the base, with approximately 20-25% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution occurring as localized speckling and clusters across the ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed high-contrast white mottling across both lobes. Left lobe exhibits dense, fine granular white speckling. Right lobe contains larger, distinct circular white clusters and irregular white patches concentrated in the medial and distal regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped median notch with an approximate vertex angle of 80 degrees; depth occupies roughly 12% of the visible vertical span of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire trailing edge; pixel amplitude of peaks varies between 3-10 pixels from the baseline edge, creating a jagged silhouette against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a moderate concave curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to a slight convexity towards the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (5-15 pixel diameters) resembling rosette patterns, primarily concentrated on the lower half of the right lobe and scattered across the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (15-50 pixels in length) visible on the interior portion of the right lobe and central transition area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent clusters of raised, textured, brownish-grey biological growth (barnacle colonies) are affixed to the extreme distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive thick, irregular protrusions at the fluke tips caused by dense barnacle colonization, altering the expected smooth geometric termination of the lobe tips.
